JUDGMENT
NON REPORTABLE 
  IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA
                CRIMINAL ORIGINAL JURISDICTION
   CRIMINAL APPEAL NO.1239 OF 2015
      (Arising out of SLP(Crl.)No.6370 of 2015)
    VISHAL MAHAJAN  
         ... APPELLANT(S) 
            VS.
    STATE OF PUNJAB & ORS.           ... RESPONDENT(S)
           J U D G M E N T
ANIL R. DAVE, J.
1.
Though served, nobody appears for the  respondent-
wife.
2.
Leave granted.
3.
Upon perusal of the impugned order, we find that a 
statement  had  been  made  by  the  petitioner-husband  with 
regard to settlement among the parties.
4.
Looking   at  the  facts  of  the  case,  the  direction 
regarding the cost awarded i.e. Rs.20,000/- (Rupees twenty 
thousand) shall stand deleted as the statement made by the 
petitioner-husband before the High Court was correct.
1

Page 2
JUDGMENT
5.
The  appeal  is  disposed  of  as  allowed  to  the  above 
extent.
      
 ..............J.
[ANIL R. DAVE]
................J.
[ADARSH KUMAR GOEL]
New Delhi;
21st September, 2015.
